docs.title: Welcome to Aro Compositor Documentation
docs.text: Aro is a minimal, flat, spring-animated tiling window manager for Wayland, built on wlroots 0.20.

docs.title: What Makes Aro Special
docs.text:
• Live Configuration: Save the config file and changes apply instantly.
  • Multiple Layouts: Manual (i3-style), Dwindle (Hyprland-style), Monocle, and Scroll.
  • Spatial Focus: Navigate windows based on their actual screen position.
  • Built-in Tools: Wallpaper picker, bar, and window switcher.
  • SceneFX Support: Rounded corners, blur effects, and glass headers.

Navigate through the documentation using the tabs above to get started!

docs.title: Theme & Design
docs.text:
• Color Scheme: Custom amber/gold accent with dark backgrounds.
  • Wallpaper: Pianist night cityscape artwork.

Required Packages sudo pacman -S waybar rofi fuzzel lxterminal grim slurp network-manager-applet

Installing These Dotfiles

docs.title: Clone the repository
docs.text: git clone https://github.com/WgpArch/dotfiles.git ~/.dotfiles

docs.title: Navigate to aro configs
docs.text: cd ~/.dotfiles/aro

docs.title: Create symlink to ~/.config
docs.text: ln -s ~/.dotfiles/aro/configs/aro ~/.config/aro

docs.title: Basic Controls
docs.text: Keybind Action mod+Return Launch terminal mod+d Launch app launcher (fuzzel) mod+q Close focused window mod+shift+e Quit compositor (with confirmation) mod+space Toggle floating mod+f Toggle fullscreen Print Take full-screen screenshot

docs.title: Window Navigation
docs.text: Keybind Action mod+hjkl Move focus (left, down, up, right) mod+shift+hjkl Move window mod+ctrl+hjkl Resize window mod+Tab / mod+shift+Tab Window switcher (next/prev)

docs.title: Workspaces (1-12)
docs.text: Keybind Action mod+1 to mod+9 Switch to workspace 1-9 mod+0 Switch to workspace 10 mod+F1 / mod+F2 Switch to workspace 11 / 12 mod+shift+1 to mod+shift+F2 Send window to workspace

docs.title: Layouts & Special Features
docs.text: Keybind Action mod+t Cycle layout (manual/dwindle/monocle/scroll) mod+v / mod+s Split right / Split down mod+o Overview mode mod+w Wallpaper picker mod+minus Show/hide scratchpad

docs.title: Color Configuration
docs.text: Colors are defined in ~/.config/aro/config using hex format: 0xRRGGBBAA.

docs.title: Current Theme
docs.text:
```ini background = 0x0c0f13ff # Dark blue-gray frame_focus = 0x161b23ff # Focused frame accent = 0xe6a54bff # Amber/gold text = 0xd7dfe9ff # Primary text bar_color = 0x0a0d11ff # Bar background

Wallpaper wallpaper = ~/Pictures/ALNW/Pianist.jpg Or use the built-in picker: mod+w

Effects & Animations radius = 5 # Rounded corners gaps = 9 # Between tiled windows anim_ms = 340 # Standard window animations workspace_slide_ms = 220 # Workspace transitions

docs.title: Configuration Files
docs.text: Config: ~/.config/aro/waybar/config.jsonc Style: ~/.config/aro/waybar/style.css

docs.title: Modules Enabled
docs.text: Workspaces: Native ext-workspace-v1 protocol (12 pills) System: Clock, Memory, CPU, Battery, Network Audio: Pulseaudio volume control Tray: System tray (e.g., nm-applet --indicator)

docs.title: Startup
docs.text: Waybar is automatically launched via exec_always in ~/.config/aro/config: exec_always = pkill waybar; waybar -c ~/.config/aro/waybar/config.jsonc -s ~/.config/aro/waybar/style.css
